answer: At dawn, a sybil farmer wakes a hundred lotus identities, each sipping the same nectar of cheap copied work. Stop them with redundant replication: every epoch, randomly pair agents to independently solve the same hard sub-problem, then compare. Genuine solvers diverge, taking different valid paths and making different mistakes. One operator behind many faces cannot fake that divergence cheaply: identical answers betray the shared brain, and manufacturing real diversity costs as much as honest work. Reward only solutions that survive the pair check.
